CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA
ORDER % 30.01.2026 CRL.M.A. 3133/2026 (exemption)

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
CRL.A. 110/2026 & CRL.M.(BAIL) 205/2026 (for interim suspension of sentence)
2.

The appellant seeks setting aside of judgment dated 26.11.2025 and sentence dated 18.12.2025 whereby he was convicted for offence under section 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 6 POSCO Act and was sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and pay fine of Rs. 10,000/-.
It is informed by learned counsel for appellant that fine has already been paid.
3. Learned APP for State accepts notice.
Notice to the prosecutrix through IO be also issued.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/01/2026 at 20:50:51 4.
Digitized record of the trial court be requisitioned within four weeks.
Nominal rolls also be requisitioned.
5. At this stage, learned counsel for appellant alleges that the trial court did not hear his arguments and the learned Presiding Officer of the trial court misled him.
In response to specific query, learned counsel for appellant submits that he did not file any written submissions nor any complaint in this regard.
Prima facie, the statement made by the counsel in Court is a clear contempt of the trial court.
Learned counsel is granted opportunity of two weeks to explain as to why appropriate proceedings under the Contempt of Courts Act be not initiated against him.
